observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "---script ref---" && grep -o '<script[^>]*src="[^"]*"' dist/index.html && echo "---bundle JS parse check---" && node --check dist/bundle.js && echo "bundle.js parses OK (exit $?)" && echo "---app entry marker---" && grep -o "new maplibregl.Map\|maplibregl.Map" dist/bundle.js | head -1
